requirements.text: A mobile-friendly website or app for booking study rooms easily
An online system for managing book loans, including borrowing and returning books without visiting the desk
A feature to track checked-out books, due dates, and fines in one place
Email notifications for due dates and fines to remind students
Real-time availability for study room bookings and a limit on booking times to ensure fairness
The system must prioritize simplicity and user-friendliness
